title: fix: limit model changes news card to live changes
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
The model changes card on enter listed retirements and price changes through November, most of which are not deployed yet. This trims it to what #15361 shipped to production on Sep 24.

- Lists the five models that are now Paid Pollen only
- Adds the ~5% price increase on GLM 5.2 and Kimi K2.7 Code, which was missing
- Keeps the DeepSeek V4 Flash increase, the V4 Pro / Muse Glimmer decreases and the Kimi K2.7 Code tool-call note
- Drops Sonar, Qwen, Command A+, Nova, MAI, Gemini and Grok items until their PRs ship
- Replaces the "Starting Sep 25" label with the actual date

Checked each item against the live `gen.pollinations.ai/text/models` catalog.

gist.headline: News from the living hive
gist.blurb: The model-changes card now reports what has actually landed in production, rather than consulting the calendar from the future. Five Paid Pollen-only models and the current GLM 5.2, Kimi K2.7 Code, DeepSeek V4, V4 Pro, and Muse Glimmer changes are all accounted for.
gist.summary: Updated Enter's model-changes news card to match the live Sep 24 production catalog: five Paid Pollen-only models, roughly 5% GLM 5.2 and Kimi K2.7 Code price updates, DeepSeek V4 Flash, V4 Pro, Muse Glimmer, and the Kimi tool-call note.
gist.impact: Users now see the actual deployed model availability and pricing changes, dated with the real release date, while unshipped Sonar, Qwen, Command A+, Nova, MAI, Gemini, and Grok updates stay out of the card until they land.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful newsroom editor in a cozy garden terminal, replacing a future-dated stack of model notices with a small, clearly current bulletin pinned to a lime-green board. A CRT monitor shows a tidy live model catalog, with code-plants and calendar pages representing only changes that have bloomed in production.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny editor visor, carefully pinning a current model bulletin onto a prominent lime green (#ecf874) garden news board beside a glowing retro terminal showing a live catalog; old future calendar pages rest neatly in a tray, while code-plants bloom nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, dark purple (#110518) outlines, subtle pixel-font text: 'LIVE CHANGES', nostalgic but emotionally warm.
